readme: Declarative controlled-break map consumed by scripts/scenario-receipts.mjs.
One record per scenario id. The runner applies `edits` to `breakFile` inside an
ISOLATED COPY of the working tree, never in the shared tree, then emits the four
receipts scenario-state-resolve.sh derives RED_VERIFIED / IMPLEMENTED /
GREEN_TARGETED / REGRESSION_GREEN from.
Fields:
test               test identity, sourced from the manifest `linkedTests` and
verified against it at run time (a mismatch is refused).
breakFile          repo-relative file the break is applied to.
edits[]            {find, replace}; each `find` MUST occur exactly once or the
scenario is refused rather than guessed at. Either side may
be an array of lines, which is joined with newlines.
control            the negative control. RED and GREEN cite it byte-identically;
scenario-state-resolve.sh:406 refuses SCS-CONTROL-SUBSTITUTED
otherwise. The runner emits one string to both, so they cannot drift.
claim              the claim the receipt is evidence for.
implementationRefs production paths the scenario's behavior lives in.
vacuous            set true, with vacuousReason, when the behavior CANNOT be broken
in a way that fails its own test. That is a real finding about the
test, and it is recorded here rather than papered over with an
invented break.
An entry is only worth anything once the runner has actually executed it and
observed the red fail at its own assertion. An unverified entry is worse than an
absent one, because it looks like coverage.

SCN-008-001.test: tests/portfolio-survival-foundation.spec.mjs#Regression: SCN-008-001 valid local portfolio import creates one current revision
SCN-008-001.control: buildPortfolioRevision lineage removed: a committed revision records supersedes: null instead of the superseded portfolioId
SCN-008-001.claim: A confirmed import commits exactly one new current revision whose lineage names the revision it superseded

SCN-008-002.test: tests/portfolio-survival-foundation.spec.mjs#Regression: SCN-008-002 invalid or secret-bearing import is atomic and redacted
SCN-008-002.control: secret detection removed: secretFieldName and secretValue always return false, so a secret-bearing import raises no P008-IMPORT-SECRET
SCN-008-002.claim: A secret-bearing or invalid import is rejected atomically and its value is redacted rather than stored

SCN-008-003.test: tests/portfolio-survival-foundation.spec.mjs#Regression: SCN-008-003 explicit mandate alone supplies every hard constraint
SCN-008-003.control: MANDATE_NULLABLE_POLICY_FIELDS absent-detection removed so absent policy fields report 0 instead of 4
SCN-008-003.claim: Only the explicit mandate supplies hard constraints, and an absent policy field is reported absent rather than inferred

SCN-008-004.test: tests/portfolio-survival-foundation.spec.mjs#Regression: SCN-008-004 no mandate leaves goal fit and survival unavailable
SCN-008-004.control: projectRouteStates never-inferred fields seeded with 0.07 instead of null, so a missing mandate renders an inferred number
SCN-008-004.claim: With no mandate, goal fit and survival are reported unavailable rather than inferred from a default

SCN-008-005.test: tests/portfolio-survival-foundation.spec.mjs#Regression: SCN-008-005 TP-04-05 personal state coexists with the shared cache and the only published read is the constant privacy boundary
SCN-008-005.control: the published tool read declares personalDataIncluded: true, so the constant privacy boundary no longer asserts that nothing personal crossed into the shared cache
SCN-008-005.claim: Private portfolio state coexists with the shared public cache, and the only published read is the constant privacy boundary

SCN-008-011.test: tests/portfolio-survival-foundation.spec.mjs#Regression: SCN-008-011 clear behavior removes ranking influence and preserves portfolio
SCN-008-011.control: buildBehaviorClearCandidate no longer empties behaviorEvents, so a behavior clear leaves the ranking influence it claims to remove
SCN-008-011.claim: Clearing behavior removes behavior-derived ranking influence and preserves the portfolio

SCN-008-012.test: tests/portfolio-survival-foundation.spec.mjs#Regression: SCN-008-012 behavior evidence excludes engagement and sensitive profiling
SCN-008-012.control: forbiddenBehaviorField always returns false, so engagement and sensitive-profiling fields are accepted into behavior evidence
SCN-008-012.claim: Behavior evidence excludes engagement metrics and sensitive profiling fields

SCN-008-013.test: tests/portfolio-survival-risk.spec.mjs#Regression: SCN-008-013 arithmetic CAGR and conditional drag stay separate
SCN-008-013.control: compoundedCagr is assigned the arithmetic annualized value, so the CAGR row reproduces the arithmetic row instead of compounding the wealth index
SCN-008-013.claim: Arithmetic annualized return, compounded CAGR and observed volatility drag are rendered as three separate quantities and are never collapsed into one return

SCN-008-015.test: tests/portfolio-survival-risk.spec.mjs#Regression: SCN-008-015 concentration lenses expose overlap and missing look through
SCN-008-015.control: a holding the lens cannot classify is bucketed as Other and counted as covered, so an unmeasurable lens renders as complete
SCN-008-015.claim: Concentration lenses expose overlap and missing look-through rather than folding unclassifiable holdings into a complete-looking distribution

SCN-008-016.test: tests/portfolio-survival-risk.spec.mjs#Regression: SCN-008-016 beta alpha R squared and residual risk stay separate
SCN-008-016.control: beta is divided by the portfolio's own variance instead of the benchmark's, conflating the regression slope with an inverse-scaled correlation
SCN-008-016.claim: Beta, alpha, R squared and residual risk are computed and reported as separate quantities

SCN-008-017.test: tests/portfolio-survival-risk.spec.mjs#Regression: SCN-008-017 marginal and total risk contributions reconcile
SCN-008-017.control: the weight factor is dropped from the Euler contribution, so the marginal contribution is reported as the total contribution and the sum no longer reconciles to portfolio risk
SCN-008-017.claim: Marginal and total risk contributions are distinct and reconcile to portfolio risk by Euler decomposition

SCN-008-010.test: tests/portfolio-survival-brief.spec.mjs#Regression: SCN-008-010 insufficient completed history produces zero inferred actions
SCN-008-010.control: the brief always reports sufficient-history, so a history below the declared behavior floor is no longer disclosed as insufficient and the shortfall becomes invisible to the reader
SCN-008-010.claim: Below the declared behavior floor the brief states insufficient-history rather than presenting the shortfall as sufficient evidence

SCN-008-014.test: tests/portfolio-survival-risk.spec.mjs#Regression: SCN-008-014 unrecovered drawdown stops at the evidence cutoff

edits.find: var recoveryDate = null, recoveryPeriods = null, recoveryState = "unrecovered";
edits.replace: var recoveryDate = dates[dates.length - 1], recoveryPeriods = idx.length - 1, recoveryState = "recovered";

SCN-008-014.control: computeDrawdown seeds a recovery that never happened, so an episode still under water at the evidence cutoff reports a recovered state with a fabricated recovery date and duration
SCN-008-014.claim: A drawdown unrecovered at the evidence cutoff is labelled unrecovered as of that cutoff and no recovery date or duration is fabricated

SCN-008-039.test: tests/portfolio-allocation.functional.mjs#TP-13-08 a saved allocation survives a reread and is emptied by the full personal clear
SCN-008-039.control: the workspace record is dropped from the declared full-personal sweep, so a saved allocation is still readable off the storage adapters after a confirmed full-personal clear
SCN-008-039.claim: The allocation section reads empty off the storage adapters after a full-personal clear

SCN-008-023.test: tests/portfolio-survival-diversification.spec.mjs#Regression: SCN-008-023 finite tail evidence never claims universal correlation one
SCN-008-023.control: the joint-event floor in lowerTailDependence is removed, so a tail sample below the configured minimum yields a point estimate instead of being withheld as thin-tail-sample
SCN-008-023.claim: Finite tail evidence below the declared joint-event floor is explicitly unavailable rather than reported as a number

SCN-008-024.test: tests/portfolio-survival-diversification.spec.mjs#Regression: SCN-008-024 appraisal smoothing and illiquidity block mechanical decorrelation
SCN-008-024.control: appraisal and user-entered valuations are no longer flagged as smoothing-suspected, so the asset drops its de-smoothed sensitivity requirement and reads as mechanically uncorrelated
SCN-008-024.claim: An appraisal-smoothed or illiquid asset carries its smoothing caveat and requires a de-smoothed sensitivity before any diversification conclusion

SCN-008-029.test: tests/portfolio-survival-allocation.spec.mjs#Regression: SCN-008-029 conflicting constraints remain infeasible without relaxation
SCN-008-029.control: minimums that sum past the whole portfolio are downgraded from universally infeasible to a candidate-level miss, so a mandate no weight vector can satisfy reads as one unlucky candidate rather than a contradiction in the constraints
SCN-008-029.claim: Mutually conflicting constraints are reported as universally infeasible and nothing is silently relaxed

SCN-008-021.test: tests/portfolio-survival-paths.spec.mjs#Regression: SCN-008-021 missing survival definition renders distributions without probability
SCN-008-021.control: an unavailable survival definition is treated as available, so a survival probability is computed against a floor the user never stated instead of the distributions rendering without one
SCN-008-021.claim: A missing survival definition suppresses the survival probability rather than defaulting to a fabricated floor

SCN-008-035.test: tests/portfolio-survival-foundation.spec.mjs#Regression: SCN-008-035 partial data corrupt schema and localStorage disabled preserve truth
SCN-008-035.control: a holding with no usable price evidence is reported as included in valuation, so an unevidenced position is silently valued instead of being excluded by name with no substitute applied
SCN-008-035.claim: A holding whose price evidence is missing is excluded from valuation by name and no stand-in number is substituted for it

SCN-008-033.test: tests/portfolio-survival-allocation.spec.mjs#Regression: SCN-008-033 correlation never emits a substantially identical verdict
SCN-008-033.control: the replacement comparison reports itself as adjudicated, so research inputs are presented as a substantially-identical determination the product is not permitted to make
SCN-008-033.claim: Correlation and overlap are offered as research inputs only and no substantially-identical verdict is ever emitted

SCN-008-043.test: tests/portfolio-survival-foundation.spec.mjs#Regression: SCN-008-043 full personal clear tombstones derives and verifies every personal category
SCN-008-043.control: the full personal clear stops reporting that its tombstone was committed, so a completed clear becomes indistinguishable from one whose durable record was never written and the deletion cannot be verified after the fact
SCN-008-043.claim: A full personal clear commits a tombstone before deletion and reports that commit, so the clear is verifiable rather than merely asserted

SCN-008-032.test: tests/portfolio-survival-allocation.spec.mjs#Regression: SCN-008-032 efficiency claim is scoped to one tested information set
SCN-008-032.control: a result measured against one information set reports that every form of market efficiency has been refuted, so a narrow empirical finding is widened into a claim about markets in general that the sample cannot support
SCN-008-032.claim: An efficiency finding stays scoped to the one information set actually tested and never generalizes into refuting the semi-strong or strong form

SCN-008-027.test: tests/portfolio-survival-allocation.spec.mjs#Regression: SCN-008-027 allocation comparison presents tradeoffs and no universal winner

edits.find: claimBoundary: "None is labelled best or recommended; an in-sample lead is the weakest kind of evidence. No candidate is universally best, suitable, or authorized to replace the current portfolio."
edits.replace: claimBoundary: "An in-sample lead is the weakest kind of evidence. No candidate is universally best, suitable, or authorized to replace the current portfolio."

SCN-008-027.control: the allocation comparison drops its statement that no candidate is labelled best or recommended, so the surface stops disclaiming the ranking it presents and an in-sample lead reads as a recommendation
SCN-008-027.claim: The allocation comparison presents tradeoffs and states plainly that none of the six methods is labelled best or recommended

SCN-008-047.test: tests/portfolio-survival-risk.spec.mjs#Regression: SCN-008-047 mixed portfolio inputs preserve eligible risk diagnostics and partial truth

edits.find: var partial = weightResult.state === "partial" || dailyCoverage < 1 - 1e-9 || eligibility.some(function (entry) { return entry.state === "unavailable"; });

SCN-008-047.control: a portfolio with ineligible holdings and incomplete daily coverage reports its risk projection as complete, so diagnostics computed over part of the portfolio present as covering all of it
SCN-008-047.claim: A risk projection over partially eligible holdings reports itself partial and names which holdings are excluded and why

SCN-008-031.test: tests/portfolio-survival-allocation.spec.mjs#Regression: SCN-008-031 dossier separates in sample walk forward costs and trials
SCN-008-031.control: the cost-adjusted result stops subtracting trading costs, so it equals the walk-forward result and an edge that costs would have consumed survives into the dossier as if it were free to capture
SCN-008-031.claim: In-sample, walk-forward and cost-adjusted results stay three separate numbers, and the cost-adjusted one is strictly reduced by the declared costs

SCN-008-045.test: tests/portfolio-survival-foundation.spec.mjs#Regression: SCN-008-045 five year coverage measures dates appends allowed sources and preserves partial truth

edits.find: missingBounds: { start: missingStart, end: missingEnd }, disputedDates: disputedDates,
edits.replace: missingBounds: { start: false, end: false }, disputedDates: disputedDates,

SCN-008-045.control: a coverage envelope stops reporting which requested bound it failed to reach, so a two-year snapshot answering a five-year request no longer discloses that its start is missing
SCN-008-045.claim: A coverage result names exactly which requested bounds are missing, so a shorter committed snapshot cannot masquerade as the full requested window

SCN-008-044.test: tests/portfolio-survival-brief.spec.mjs#Regression: SCN-008-044 behavior identity decay floor and ranking remain canonical across every projection
SCN-008-044.control: a behavior occurrence dated after the brief's own cutoff is admitted as eligible instead of quarantined, so activity that had not happened when the brief was composed is counted into its ranking
SCN-008-044.claim: A behavior occurrence dated past the brief cutoff is quarantined rather than counted, so a brief never ranks on activity later than itself

SCN-008-041.test: tests/portfolio-privacy.functional.mjs#TP-16-12 SCN-008-041 every personal category the finished route can create is swept by one full-personal clear
SCN-008-041.control: the session-scoped personal keys are removed from the sweep entirely, so one full-personal clear no longer reaches the session store and a whole personal category the route can create survives the clear
SCN-008-041.claim: One full-personal clear sweeps every personal category the finished route can create, including the session-scoped ones

SCN-008-026.test: tests/portfolio-survival-allocation.spec.mjs#Regression: SCN-008-026 all six allocation methods share one frozen basis

edits.find: return allocationCandidate("constrained-mvo", context.normalized, context.fingerprint, solved, expectedReturns);

SCN-008-026.control: the sixth candidate is emitted under a different method identity in both its solved and its unavailable branch, so the comparison no longer presents the contracted six-method set and a reader cannot find constrained-mvo among the candidates
SCN-008-026.claim: All six allocation methods are projected against one frozen basis, each appearing under its contracted method identity with its own assumption row and availability state
